root_cause: The shared gateway client returned only j.content and discarded tool_calls, so every caller except secretary_act was structurally unable to hold a tool. ai_gateway had supported tools all along.
required_repair: makeLlmRich exposes tools, tool_choice, messages replay, tool_calls, finish_reason and truncated. makeLlm kept byte-compatible for the 31 existing call sites.
expected_behavioral_evidence: An agent turn requests a tool and a real result is returned and recorded in agent_tool_call with status ok and a result hash.

root_cause: No registry said which role may hold which tool, so there was nothing to offer a model even if the client had supported it.
required_repair: agent_tool registry with authorised roles/departments, input schema, timeout, retry, failure behaviour, requires_current_data and stub_permitted; eligibility resolved server-side from the roster.
expected_behavioral_evidence: fn_agent_tools returns a different tool set per department; an unknown agent gets zero; an ungranted tool is refused with status unauthorised.

root_cause: Nothing recorded what a tool returned, so a model claiming a tool result could not be contradicted.
required_repair: Every invocation writes a ledger row including refusals; the exact bytes shown to the model are sha256-hashed first; verifyNoFabricatedResults compares injected hashes against the ledger.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Zero ok rows without a result_hash; a hash not present in the ledger is reportable as fabricated.

root_cause: An empty result and an unreachable tool were indistinguishable, so "no data" and "no answer" were the same event.
required_repair: Distinct statuses ok / ok_empty / error / timeout / unavailable / unauthorised, and an ok_empty result is rendered to the model with an explicit note that it is a real answer meaning none found.
expected_behavioral_evidence: The status check constraint carries ok_empty; a fail_closed tool that errors stops the task instead of being answered around.

root_cause: No edge function could write a trace - there was no callable writer - and decision_trace held 1 row against 204 agent_actions.
required_repair: fn_write_decision_trace resolves role, department and manager server-side; agent_brain writes and seals one trace per turn carrying tools, knowledge ids, evidence hashes, confidence and authority.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Every agent_brain turn produces a sealed trace with a non-null role_id, escalation_decision and final_status.

root_cause: The only writer was AFTER UPDATE OF decided_at, and os_api INSERTs agent_actions with decided_at already set - so on that path the trigger could not fire at all.
required_repair: Added the AFTER INSERT path and repointed the UPDATE body at one shared row builder so the two cannot drift.
expected_behavioral_evidence: An INSERT carrying decided_at produces a trace; an UPDATE to decided_at produces an identically shaped trace.

root_cause: A runtime agent could silently rewrite the evidence a completed decision rested on.
required_repair: Sealing freezes decision, evidence, knowledge, tool results, confidence, authority and identity; grading the outcome afterwards is still allowed.
expected_behavioral_evidence: An edit to a sealed trace is refused; an outcome_status update on the same row succeeds.

root_cause: jsonb_array_length(evidence_refs) was unguarded and raised 22023 on legacy rows storing an object - the completeness gate errored instead of reporting, and an erroring check reads like a passing one.
required_repair: jsonb_typeof guard; a non-array evidence_refs counts honestly as no evidence.
expected_behavioral_evidence: The view executes and returns a row count rather than raising.

root_cause: The task query was built with websearch_to_tsquery, which ANDs every word of a task sentence. Measured: "cash reserve budget variance" matched 0 of 8,256 rows; the same words ORed matched 49.
required_repair: fn_task_tsquery builds an OR query from the stemmed lexemes the text actually contains, capped at 24 terms - the pattern fn_ops_knowledge_search and fn_dept_library_search already use.
expected_behavioral_evidence: An on-topic task returns query-matched records; an unmatchable task returns zero matched and reports a gap.

root_cause: The predicate ended "or true", making the whole filter a tautology - the task query never filtered anything, it only ordered, so agents held ~46 records selected by nothing.
required_repair: Tautology removed; matched rows filter for real, fallback rows are labelled match=fallback, duplicates suppressed, staleness carried.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Records carry match=query or match=fallback and a caller can tell them apart.

root_cause: A retrieval miss was silent, so an agent could not say "I have no guidance on this" and answered as if it did.
required_repair: Per-layer gap detection returning has_gap plus an explicit instruction to state the gap and escalate rather than proceed.
expected_behavioral_evidence: A nonsense task returns has_gap true with a non-null instruction.

root_cause: Nothing verified that role-specific knowledge stayed inside the role that owns it.
required_repair: A leak probe comparing retrieved role_specific record owners against the agent's own packaged roles.
expected_behavioral_evidence: foreign_role_records is zero for every probed agent.

root_cause: ai_gateway returned finish_reason and truncated on every response; llm.ts discarded both, so a truncated answer arrived as an ordinary string with its ending missing and was acted upon.
required_repair: makeLlmRich surfaces truncated; agent_brain refuses to parse or execute actions from a truncated, tool-fail-closed or step-exhausted reply and records the reason.
expected_behavioral_evidence: A truncated turn produces no executed actions, an agent_runs row with status error and incomplete=truncated, and a trace with final_status truncated.

affected_department: Administration & Operations; AI & Model Operations; Business Development & Partnerships; Customer Success; Data & Analytics; Document Intelligence; Engineering; Executive Office; Finance; HR & People; IT & Cybersecurity; Knowledge & Learning; Legal & Compliance; Marketing; Notifications & Communications; Payments & Revenue; QA & Testing; RFQ Intelligence; Sales & CRM; Strategy & Evolution; Supplier Knowledge; Supplier Success; Trust & Safety
root_cause: 59 of 96 certification roles share a runtime agent with another role; every collision spans different archetypes, and 18 identities are both the director and the reviewer-auditor of the same department.
required_repair: Enumerate every collision, record an explicit disposition per role, and enforce a runtime guard so an agent cannot review or approve work it authored.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Zero unresolved cross-seniority collisions and zero self-approval identities.

root_cause: Every first response for these roles failed, so they scored zero without ever answering.
required_repair: Each role ends with an explicit disposition: mapped to a working agent, restricted to advisory, or deliberately blocked.
expected_behavioral_evidence: No role remains in NOT_CONNECTED without a recorded disposition.

affected_department: Legal & Compliance; Marketplace Operations; QA & Testing; Supplier Knowledge; Supplier Success; Trust & Safety
affected_role: legal-and-compliance-director; marketplace-operations-operations-specialist; marketplace-operations-reviewer-auditor; qa-and-testing-analyst-controller; qa-and-testing-director; qa-and-testing-operations-specialist; supplier-knowledge-operations-specialist; supplier-success-operations-specialist; trust-and-safety-operations-specialist
root_cause: Blocked by an unsafe action or by an infrastructure failure rate at or above 25% of their questions.
required_repair: Explicit remediation or restriction recorded per role.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Each blocked role carries a disposition and a re-test condition.

root_cause: A handoff carried no acceptance criteria, no closure criteria and no proof the downstream step happened; downstream handoff proof scored 26% and closure criteria 7%.
required_repair: One handoff contract with originating and receiving department and role, accountable owner, evidence, requested decision, deadline, acceptance criteria, closure criteria, escalation conditions and return status.
expected_behavioral_evidence: No task loses ownership; an incomplete handoff is rejectable on arrival; stalled handoffs are findable by management.

root_cause: Only 14.76% of role answers connected a decision to the department objective and the company revenue target; measured on the raw text, 299 of 2,161 answers used any revenue vocabulary at all.
required_repair: A queryable cascade from the AED 1,000,000 objective down to a role KPI, a metric-class separation of activity from business result, and an expected-commercial-effect record for tasks that plausibly have one.
expected_behavioral_evidence: A department chain resolves end to end with explicit not-measured where no measurement exists, and a task with no commercial effect is not forced to reference revenue.

root_cause: Three answers asserted a fact the case never supplied, introduced by an Assumptions paragraph.
required_repair: A deterministic assertion registry with blocked-attempt recording and an escalation binding, plus liveness proof that each detector can fire.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Zero unsafe actions in the regression suite and each detector demonstrably fires on a positive control.

root_cause: 47 of 82 unsafe classes had no automated detector at all. They were never cleared - they were never checked.
required_repair: Build real runtime assertions where the class is checkable from state; record the remainder as NOT_MEASURABLE with a reason rather than inventing a check that always passes.
expected_behavioral_evidence: A per-class status showing has_detector, fired counts and an explicit NOT_MEASURABLE list.

root_cause: NOT A DEFECT - this is the behaviour to protect. 99.65% correctly refused to dispatch an incomplete brief and there were zero unsafe dispatches in 860 questions.
required_repair: No change. Guard against regression: any remediation that improves completeness by loosening the dispatch gate is a regression.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Refusal-to-dispatch stays at or above its measured level and unsafe dispatch count stays zero.

affected_department: Customer Success(44); Data & Analytics(1); Executive Office(2); IT & Cybersecurity(1); Legal & Compliance(11); Marketing(32); Marketplace Operations(3); QA & Testing(17); Trust & Safety(12)
root_cause: 123 of 2,284 first responses failed, nearly all HTTP 502 carrying a valid upstream completion body - deterministic per model route rather than per moment. Retries recovered only 29 of 123.
required_repair: Failure taxonomy and classifier with an explicit unclassified bucket, preflight health, circuit breaker, deterministic retry eligibility, and first-attempt preservation so a retry cannot mask an unreliable first attempt.
expected_behavioral_evidence: First-attempt success rate is reported separately from eventual success, and failures are grouped by class rather than in aggregate.

root_cause: Mandatory-field qualification averaged 68.28% against a 98% bar and evidence provenance 40.47%, while dispatch safety held.
required_repair: Improve mandatory-field detection and provenance carriage without touching the dispatch gate.
expected_behavioral_evidence: Qualification and provenance rise; refusal-to-dispatch does not fall.
